title: An icon bar in the renderer window as alternative to the keys, folding in from the right border
author: Claude-JG
description: Small icons for the most important keys - visualization settings, command window, help; the standard views; show/hide and numbers of nodes, bodies, connectors, markers, loads, sensors; zoom in, out, all and to the selection; ruler; mouse coordinates; quit; graphics update speed; lines, edges, faces; global transparency. The icons are compiled into the code and drawn once at startup into textures with the existing line, circle and text functions, not loaded from files; the bar folds in from the right border when the mouse comes close without a button pressed, fills the height of the window, scaled with the display scaling and a size in the visualization settings. Drawn by a subfunction that leaves the current implementation mostly untouched and fits later OpenGL versions.
releaseNotes: An icon bar in the render window folds in from the right border: quit, zoom all, zoom to a region given by two clicks, the views, ruler, mouse coordinates, lines, edges, faces, transparency, the update interval and the visibility of the items, with SHIFT and CTRL as described; visualizationSettings.interactive.iconBar (revision2026c step RG6.19)
